title: THE ATTRACT PAGES GROW WITH A 4K SCREEN
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): take pictures at 1080p and 4K and make sure the menus look good. On the 4K picture of the arcade HOW TO PLAY page the page was half the size it is at 1080p, its column heads tiny, because its type stopped growing at a size meant for smaller screens. It now grows with the screen, so a 4K TV shows it at the same share of the screen as a 1080p one.
now: The arcade attract pages fill a 4K screen as they do a 1080p one.

edits.replacement: 'font:800 clamp(12px,1.15vw,60px) var(--f-cond);letter-spacing:.08em;color:#f2e6c8;text-shadow:0 2px 0 #000;text-align:center}'+   // vNN.xx (ui5q1u): the same share of a 4K screen as of 1080p (the cap was 30px)
